newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 14.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Education Ministry calls for increased vigilance against child abuse from teachers and school staff.
-- Jean-Martin Folz to join PSA Peugeot Citroen board apparently to prepare for succession to chairman Jacques Calvet.
-- A French subsidiary of Daewoo has been placed under legal investigation for a two-year period, after an engineer died in a fatal accident in October 1996.
-- Borrowers benefit from fierce competition in real-estate lending, as sluggish demand drives banks to offer attractive rates.
